purpose: State that failing to act would be unacceptable.
keywords: ない-form → なければ + いけない.
I have to get up early tomorrow.
I have to tidy the room.
formation: ない-form → なければ + いけない.
restrictions: Common for practical duties or requirements.
mistake: The whole expression obliges the action despite its negative components.
